longTitle: A Bill to make provision for the relocation of Billingsgate Market and the London Central Markets; and for connected purposes.
petitioningPeriod: House of Commons petitioning period: 31 January to 9 February.
petitionInformation:
If you are directly and specially affected by this legislation, you can petition against it in the House of Commons. For information about how to petition, please click here.


The petitioning period will open at 9am on 31 January and close on 9 February. To submit your petition against the Bill, please do so via the online portal, which you can access here.


For further information, you can contact the Private Bill Office by emailing PRBOHOC@Parliament.uk.
